payload.rebuttal: argued: `_spans()`'s return order has no observable effect anywhere downstream. `_attribute` only checks `span.start <= epoch < span.end` per span and looks the result up by `spans[matched[0]]` using whatever list it was given, never comparing index values to anything meaningful, and the floor-share guard sums over all spans regardless of order too. `materialize`'s `spans_by_spec` dict, the only other place the list is kept, is written and never read again (confirmed by grep: only two hits, both assignments). Reversing the list is a true no-op for every consumer, so this is an equivalent mutant: no test, including a hypothetical better one, can observe a difference, because there is none.
